mapper.select: /* CommonMenuMapper.selectList */ WITH W_TMP AS ( SELECT A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID, A.AI_INPT_MENU_NO, A.AI_INPT_MENU_NM, A.AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID, B.AI_INPT_AUT_USG_YN, A.AI_INPT_MGPE_YN, A.AI_INPT_MENU_URL_NM FROM CSPD108TI A, CSPD109TI B WHERE B.AI_INPT_MENU_ID = A.AI_INPT_MENU_ID AND B.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = #{schAuth} AND ( ('Y' != #{schAdminYN} AND A.AI_INPT_MGPE_YN = 'N') OR ('Y' = #{schAdminYN} AND A.AI_INPT_MGPE_YN IN ('N', 'Y')) ) AND B.AI_INPT_AUT_USG_YN = 'Y' ), W_TMP2 AS ( SELECT C.AI_INPT_MENU_ID, C.AI_INPT_MENU_NO, C.AI_INPT_MENU_NM, C.AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID, C.AI_INPT_MGPE_YN, C.AI_INPT_MENU_URL_NM , CASE WHEN C.AI_INPT_MENU_NO IS NULL AND 1 > ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM W_TMP D WHERE D.AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID = C.AI_INPT_MENU_ID AND D.AI_INPT_AUT_USG_YN = 'Y' ) THEN 'N' ELSE C.AI_INPT_AUT_USG_YN END AS AI_INPT_AUT_USG_YN FROM W_TMP C ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT E.AI_INPT_MENU_ID, E.AI_INPT_MENU_NO, E.AI_INPT_MENU_NM, E.AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID, E.AI_INPT_MGPE_YN, E.AI_INPT_MENU_URL_NM , CASE WHEN E.AI_INPT_MENU_NO IS NULL AND E.AI_INPT_MENU_ID IN ('100000', '200000', '300000', '400000', '500000') AND 1 > ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM W_TMP2 D WHERE D.AI_INPT_HGRN_MENU_ID = E.AI_INPT_MENU_ID AND D.AI_INPT_AUT_USG_YN = 'Y' ) THEN 'N' ELSE E.AI_INPT_AUT_USG_YN END AS AI_INPT_AUT_USG_YN FROM W_TMP2 E ) F WHERE F.AI_INPT_MENU_ID != '000000' AND F.AI_INPT_AUT_USG_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY AI_INPT_MENU_ID, AI_INPT_MENU_NO, AI_INPT_MENU_NM
/* CommonMenuMapper.selectListTotCnt */ SELECT COUNT(*) totcnt FROM CSPD108TI WHERE 1=1
